propositions: rebar's LLM runtime branches on provider-name strings rather than using pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook, conflating provider selection logic across multiple modules
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic has no native support path; the only workaround (gateway-fronted OpenAI-compatible) silently loses prompt caching, retry tenacity, timeouts, and structured output
base_url and api_key configuration is documented as working but rejected at runtime by _pai_check_config, making the documented OpenAI-compatible-endpoint flow inoperable
signed verdict sidecars record model strings that no longer name the actual provider or endpoint when routed through gateways, losing audit transparency
retry and timeout configuration does not reach Bedrock's botocore client, leaving production (which runs on Bedrock) with unconfigured transport
capability selection (output mode, caching, thinking) is hardcoded to provider-name matching rather than reading ModelProfile, preventing per-model and per-tier behavior
